events.title: Diageo's Indian unit's profit jumps on premium demand
events.body: May 14 (Reuters) - India's United Spirits, which distributes Johnnie Walker and Antiquity whiskeys, posted about a 27% rise in fourth quarter profit on Friday, boosted by demand for its premium brands

events.title: Heineken focuses agency roster on fewer future-fit partners
events.body: Dentsu retains global media duties, extending a decade-long relationship, while creative is being consolidated with Publicis, WPP and Stagwell.

events.title: Ex-Mars CEO named Lipton chair
events.body: Grant Reid joins the hot-drinks group, which hired a new CEO in October.
